blockers.case: intStepBranch bPers eH nwH = none implies IBranchSaturation
blockers.root_cause: When intStepBranch returns none, every compound formula sf in bPers is in eH (since intApplyRuleFull sf ... ≠ .notApplicable for compound sf). But being in eH only means sf was previously expanded; it does NOT immediately imply the rule outputs are on bPers unless the expanded-set invariant is carried through the induction.
blockers.invariant_needed: ExpandedSetInvariant(bPers, eH): for every sf ∈ eH, sf's rule outputs (per intApplyRuleFull) are on bPers. Specifically: T(φ∧ψ)@w ∈ eH → T(φ)@w ∈ bPers ∧ T(ψ)@w ∈ bPers; F(φ∧ψ)@w ∈ eH → F(φ)@w ∈ bPers ∨ F(ψ)@w ∈ bPers; T(φ∨ψ)@w ∈ eH → similar; F(φ∨ψ)@w ∈ eH → similar; F(φ→ψ)@w ∈ eH → ∃ w'≥w, T(φ)@w' ∈ bPers ∧ F(ψ)@w' ∈ bPers.
blockers.fix: Strengthen intExpandBranches_openBranch_sat to add `hinv: ∀ b e, (b,e) ∈ branches.zip expandedSets → ExpandedSetInvariant b e` as precondition, and prove the invariant is maintained: (1) empty expanded set satisfies it vacuously; (2) when a linear rule fires on sf adding newForms, ExpandedSetInvariant(bPers++newForms, eH++[sf]) follows from ExpandedSetInvariant(bPers,eH) plus newForms containing the rule outputs; (3) persistence monotonically extends the branch, preserving the invariant; (4) for sat_fimp, the world ordering w≤w' follows from the world counter being strictly increasing (freshness lemmas already in Soundness.lean).
